businessObjects.name: Product Catalog
businessObjects.businessPurpose: To maintain a structured, standardized, and searchable inventory of available grocery items to enable customer discovery and order placement.
businessObjects.evidenceSummary: Inferred from industry standards for e-commerce and grocery delivery; supported by evidence regarding the necessity of product catalog management for organizing large inventories and enhancing product discovery for online shoppers.

businessObjects.name: Order Record
businessObjects.businessPurpose: To capture the specific selection of items, quantities, delivery details, and payment information for a single customer transaction.
businessObjects.evidenceSummary: Inferred from the definition of online grocery services where customers order items; supported by evidence stating that grocery delivery startups deal with large inventories and that catalogs ensure products are categorized to allow customers to find what they need.

businessObjects.name: Delivery Order
businessObjects.businessPurpose: To assign a specific customer order to a fulfillment agent (courier) for physical transport from the store to the customer's location.
businessObjects.evidenceSummary: Inferred from the nature of 'on-demand' and 'delivery' services described in the domain; supported by evidence mentioning the operational challenges and business model requirements for fast grocery delivery which necessitates a hand-off to a delivery mechanism.

businessObjects.name: Financial Settlement Record
businessObjects.businessPurpose: To record the finalized payment, fees, and revenue recognition resulting from a completed transaction.
businessObjects.evidenceSummary: Inferred from the requirement for businesses to be profitable and manage costs mentioned in startup case studies; supported by evidence discussing the need for startups to find a profitable business model and manage investment costs/fees.
